entry.title: Truck Stop Fitness
entry.subtitle: Chief Operating Officer
entry.description: A small startup business focused around providing health and wellness facilities to long-haul truckers throughout the US. Built connections, developed a business plan, and solicited financial investment. Currently on hiatus while other founders pivot to different projects.
entry.technology: Business Management | Startup Finance | Stakeholder Communication

entry.title: Shiver Entertainment (Nintendo)
entry.subtitle: Optimization Specialist Engineer
entry.description: Used as a trusted contractor by several AAA studios, Shiver Entertainment is one of the foremost experts in optimizing software to run on lower powered systems (particularly the Nintendo Switch). Despite having been acquired by Nintendo, Shiver is perhaps most commonly known for their close working relationship with Warner Brothers Games and subsidiaries, with several major titles having their Switch ports done by Shiver.

entry.title: Frontline Foam
entry.subtitle: Manufacturing Manager
entry.description: A local small business devoted to custom Nerf foam blasters. I worked as the head of the manufacturing department, while also spending time with marketing and product development. Learned manufacturing methods, marketing plans, and helped design new systems to improve order fulfillment and marketing workflows.
entry.technology: Business Management | Metalworking | Social Media Marketing | Process Improvement

entry.title: Virtel
entry.subtitle: Virtual Reality Language Learning
entry.description: Virtel was a small team working to create software for foreign language education in Virtual Reality. Although now defunct, the startup was at one point poised to publish an initial package of Latin American Spanish learning environments and activities.

entry.title: Mozenda
entry.subtitle: Commercial Web Scraping
entry.description: Mozenda is a SaaS Web Scraping company based out of Utah. Clients contract an individual specialist to design and customize agents built using Mozenda's proprietary software, as well as data post-processing and formatting.

entry.title: Game Engine Development
entry.description: Working within various Engines, there's a lot of things that you need to pick up to keep things moving forward. Keeping them straight is a lot easier than re-learning every time you swap projects!
entry.technology: C++ | Unreal | Unity | Python Tools | Optimization

entry.title: Game Design
entry.description: Working within the concepts of game theory, interpersonal interactions, and simple fun experiences. Focus on simple and explicit documentation, plus a deep understanding of implementation goals.

entry.title: Embedded Systems
entry.description: Very familiar with the C language, having worked with Arduino, the MSP430, and the PINQ board. Also includes (tangentially related) experience using FPGAs and building software defined processors. "I hope you're tired of Object Oriented Programming!"

entry.description: Certainly the most Wizard-y game in recent memory; Hogwarts Legacy succeeded in bringing the Magical world to life in a way that other games can only dream of. I'm so tired of looking at robes.

entry.title: H3VR Gun Game
entry.subtitle: Now spawning worse weapons and more enemies!
entry.description: H3VR is the single largest and best engineered Gun simulator in VR. Based on its extensive modding support, Gun Game brings the classic game mode from Call of Duty into H3. Originally developed by KacperObara, I designed several gameplay improvements that I had wanted included in the mod, which were then merged back into main.
